claims.text: For \(c=6\), accepted artifact `162283c7d25bcc9b6cf77717e180ce1c85e4bdcbe2d0dbabc186aab75e18d126` records \[ (\operatorname{rank}Q_d)_{d=4}^{8}=(1,1,2,1,1), \quad Q_d=0\ (9\le d\le32), \] with no torsion in every recorded degree.

Relative to accepted generation of \[ G_L=\{\bar s_\mu:2^2\subseteq\mu\subseteq2^4\},\qquad G_R=\{\bar s_\mu:2^2\subseteq\mu\subseteq4^2\}, \] each six-element family maps onto \(Q\cong\mathbb Z^6\). The accepted indexed-family Nakayama criterion therefore makes each image a \(\mathbb Z\)-basis of \(Q\), so neither \(G_L\) nor \(G_R\) has a removable generator.
The requested \(i=j=p=2,\ c=6\) minimality corollary is established relative to the accepted computation dependency and accepted generation criterion; no parent-theorem claim is made.
